description:
https://www.playstation.com/

Play as Wolverine as he searches for answers about his past with the PlayStation®5 Digital Edition – Marvel’s Wolverine Battle Yellow Limited Edition Bundle.
 
Inspired by Insomniac’s Battle Reborn suit, this limited edition bundle reflects the relentless ferocity with which Wolverine fights, cutting down anyone who dares face him.
 
PlayStation®5 Digital Edition – Marvel’s Wolverine Battle Yellow Limited Edition Bundle includes a PS5 Digital Edition console with Limited Edition console covers, a Limited Edition DualSense wireless controller, and a download code for the game(1).

Marvel’s Wolverine Limited Edition accessories can also be purchased separately(2), including:

* Marvel’s Wolverine Limited Edition Battle Yellow or Adamantium DualSense® Wireless Controllers
* Marvel’s Wolverine Limited Edition Battle Yellow Console Covers for PS5(3) and PS5 Pro(4) consoles.
* Marvel’s Wolverine Limited Edition Adamantium Console Covers for PS5 Pro(4) consoles.
title: Marvel's Wolverine - Limited Edition Marvel’s Wolverine Bundle and Accessories | PS5

description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017993

We're excited to announce that Farming Camp will launch on September 24th. 

Get ready to plant crops, care for animals, and become the next best Evertree Farmer! Discover Farming Camp, a cozy game set in a summer camp where you can grow crops, care for adorable animals, and enjoy relaxing activities in a charming pixel art world. 

This experience blends the essence of relaxing farming games with a warm, wholesome setting—perfect for cozy game fans looking to unwind. But Farming Camp offers more: it’s also a competition where some campers may resort to sabotage to win. With a light yet engaging narrative, charismatic characters, and unexpected twists, it delivers a unique take on cozy games by combining relaxation, storytelling, and rivalry into one memorable experience.

#ps5 #ps5games
title: Farming Camp - Session Trailer | PS5 Games
